frozenQuestion: Can temporary, intermittent, sensing, and movement-mediated dynamic fault processes be executed reproducibly over the validated regeneration checkpoints with calibrated hazards and durations, isolated random streams, exact cost accounting, and an explicit RNG-coupling boundary?

inherits.checkpointState: occupancy, Selection cursors, activation count/global event clock, stream counters, ledger, and S04 process state

runtimeOverlay.rootScenarioId: retain the original executable S01 scenario ID for scheduler, policy, and S04 process streams
runtimeOverlay.processStateLocation: typed runtime state outside immutable Scenario cells and outside policy-visible observations
runtimeOverlay.mechanicalPlacement: after policy proposal construction and authoritative mechanical validation, before conflict resolution and commit
runtimeOverlay.temporaryFreezeMobility: while active, the selected identity may neither initiate a state change nor be the target of a Swap
runtimeOverlay.claimBoundary: the overlay is mobility-equivalent for eligible state changes but is not byte-equivalent to rebuilding a static stuck Scenario

profiles.onset: exact S02 checkpoint after the S03 anchor lesion and before the first recovery opportunity
profiles.targetSelection: identity at floor((n-1)/2) in post-anchor occupancy
profiles.failureSemantics: complete runtime mobility block for the selected identity
profiles.recoverySemantics: recover before opportunity onset+16; active for exactly 16 charged opportunities unless the task terminates first

profiles.onset: exact S02 checkpoint after the S03 anchor lesion and before the first recovery opportunity
profiles.targetSelection: identity at floor((n-1)/2) in post-anchor occupancy
profiles.failureSemantics: complete runtime mobility block for the selected identity
profiles.recoverySemantics: while active, consume one recovery-hazard draw per charged opportunity; a hit recovers after that opportunity, giving geometric support 1,2,...

profiles.transitionTiming: one transition draw before each charged proposal outcome
profiles.failureSemantics: post-transition failed state rejects an otherwise eligible Swap; NoOp and MemoryUpdate are unchanged

profiles.drawSemantics: one value draw per authorized logical read and one status draw per authorized other-cell read

profiles.loadIncrement: one per identity participation in an accepted Swap, for both initiator and displaced identity
profiles.failureSemantics: on reaching threshold, reset load and block the identity from initiating a state change or being swapped for the next 8 charged opportunities
profiles.recoverySemantics: deterministic cooldown on the global opportunity clock; load remains zero at recovery

shamProfile.semantics: execute from the identical post-anchor state with no dynamic process; do not consume dummy process draws

streamRegistry.name: temporary_freeze_recovery_hazard_s04_v1
streamRegistry.address: (original executable scenario ID, global opportunity index, draw index 0)
streamRegistry.consumption: one draw per active frozen opportunity

streamRegistry.name: intermittent_movement_transition_s04_v1
streamRegistry.address: (original executable scenario ID, global opportunity index, draw index 0)

streamRegistry.name: probabilistic_sensing_status_s04_v1
streamRegistry.address: (original executable scenario ID, global opportunity index, authorized read ordinal)
streamRegistry.consumption: one draw per authorized other-cell read

pairingContract.preProcess: active and matched sham share the exact S02 checkpoint and S03 anchor-lesion state
pairingContract.baseRuntimeRoot: same original executable scenario ID and seed
pairingContract.processStreams: active-only, semantically isolated, and never substituted for a base or other process stream
pairingContract.staticReconstructionContrast: scenario_paired_rng_unpaired because changing immutable fault content changes the executable scenario ID
pairingContract.countChangingLesions: not_executable in this fixed-identity S04 runtime panel

calibration.probabilityTolerance: absolute z score <= 6.0 under the declared binomial law

validationPanel.sourceConstruction: exact reconstruction of all validated S02 checkpoints followed by the validated S03 central segment reversal anchor

claimBoundary: S04 validates transparent computational fault-process semantics and calibration. It does not establish biological damage, fatigue, recovery, regeneration, or causal efficacy outside the declared simulator.
